What is the Saskatchewan Polytechnic acceptance rate for International Students?

The Saskatchewan Polytechnic acceptance rate is 96%.

The facilities at Saskatchewan Polytechnic are far-ranging and comprehensive in supporting your student experience.

Students can also find a dental clinic, fitness and recreation centre, salon, spas and multifunction printers at Saskatchewan Polytechnic.

Student Life

Campus tours with caring student staff are available to show you the key student areas around campus, or you can explore your surroundings with a 360 virtual tour. Equal opportunities are prioritised at Saskatchewan Polytechnic, with accessibility services catering to those with access support needs and counselling services available to improve the mental health of students, where required.

There are also a number of student societies for you to join upon arrival so you can enjoy a varied student life while gaining access to invaluable information.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Several on-campus accommodation options are available to students at Saskatchewan Polytechnic. The four campus locations: Moose Jaw, Prince Albert, Regina, Saskatoon have slight variations on accommodation available, from a student village to traditional student housing. Moose Jaw only offers off-campus accommodation. Dedicated support in finding the right housing solution for you is ubiquitous throughout the campuses.

There is a free housing registry with no reservation required to help you find a housing arrangement before you come to study at Saskatchewan Polytechnic. Links to short-term housing are also provided on their website, if applicable. Canada also offers a homestay programme for international students to immerse themselves in Canadian life by staying with a Canadian family.
